summary: Backend + Admin frontend verified for Coach K Studio round-3 features. 13/13 new pytest cases pass (tracking, insights aggregation with all required keys, session PUT status to completed/no-show, weekly recurring sessions creating 4 sessions for 2 weeks x Mon+Wed, contract email happy-path with delivered@resend.dev returns 200 & status='sent' & sent_to set, contract email w/ empty client email returns 400, lead POST 200 with best-effort owner notification). Legacy backend_test.py (23 tests) untouched. Admin UI: Insights page loads with all required data-testid stats/panels/charts and both social-facebook-card & social-instagram-card render disabled Connect buttons. Client detail Schedule tab shows session-status-<id> selects that switch to Completed/No-show live; Add training day modal exposes session-repeat-toggle, weekday-0..6 chips and session-weeks input. Contracts tab renders email-contract-<id> button (enabled when client has email) alongside PDF/Upload signed. Payments modal Method select includes PayPal, Venmo, Zelle. Marketing home shows 'Coach K Studio', 'Argyle, TX', announcement 'Now coaching women in Argyle, TX' and 'Payments accepted: PayPal · Venmo · Zelle'. No 'KP Studio' string remaining anywhere on marketing or admin. No JS console errors on any screen (the two 401s during the pre-login state are the expected /auth/me probes noted in iteration_2).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 913 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, clients, contracts, payments, leads, sessions, insights, email) for maintainability.
ClientDetail.jsx is ~335 lines and holds four modals + four tabs; extracting SessionsTab, ContractsTab, PaymentsTab into separate files would ease future changes.
/api/track is unauthenticated and unrate-limited — a bot could inflate metrics. Consider a simple per-IP rate limit or origin check on POST /api/track.
email_contract() reads/re-builds the PDF each time it emails — fine for current volume but could be cached along with the stored contract if usage grows.
The session status <select> has no explicit aria-label; screen readers will announce it as an unnamed select. Minor a11y improvement.
test_credentials: kendra@kpstudio.com / KPStudio2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Contract email tests used delivered@resend.dev as instructed.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ clients (TEST_Sess_..., TEST_Email_..., TEST_NoEmail_...) with contracts/sessions remain in Mongo for retest convenience; several TEST_ leads and ~20 track events also present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend endpoints tested in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Legacy CRUD/contract/payment/lead tests live in backend_test.py. UI data-testids verified: insights-page, social-{facebook,instagram}-card, connect-{facebook,instagram}-btn (disabled), panel-* charts, session-status-<id>, session-repeat-toggle, weekday-0..6, session-weeks, email-contract-<id>, log-payment-btn (modal has PayPal/Venmo/Zelle). Test clients left in DB start with 'TEST_'.
